source_pins.significance: Certifier operational stewardship and certification-decision integrity; no explicit authorizer for a new cross-institution wire contract verified
Founder or designated institutional steward explicitly among Registry governance authorities; records require attribution and defined decisions
Active 1.0.0 creation policy; Registry owns creation; source owner retains source authority
Registrability before Registry record construction; eligibility is Registry decision
Validation of constructed entry does not itself publish, certify, or register

owner_proposals.authority_basis_confirmed: Certifier Governance maintains operations and canonical Certification Package; role empowered to adopt external machine exchange format NOT verified from inspected documents
owner_proposals.authority_question: Which Certifier-authorized role or founder-governed decision process may approve new producer representation?
owner_proposals.decision_request: Approve, reject, or return for evidence a specific canonical producer representation, with full source identity/version/status/outcome, validity/freshness and external reference constraints
required_evidence: Identify lawful institutional decision role and source policy or delegated authority
Specify machine representation and status/outcome field meanings; reconcile draft schema, toolkit schema and canonical Package
State effective version, intended consumers, provenance, unknown/unavailable and historical/current distinctions
Define exact source-origin verification and change-control/audit record

owner_proposals.authority_basis_confirmed: Registry Governance explicitly includes Founder or designated institutional steward; material decisions still require appropriate authority and a governed record
owner_proposals.authority_question: Will the Founder acting in a documented Registry governance capacity, or another designated role, approve a specifically scoped receiving contract?
owner_proposals.decision_request: Approve, reject, or return for evidence an explicit receiver model (including the option to authorize NO automatic intake), separate from any existing SREG output profile
required_evidence: Name Registry decision-maker role and its scope, authority source and governance decision record
Specify intake contract or explicit no-automated-intake position; identify allowed request and refusal types
Separate registrability, SREG construction, validation, publication, identifier assignment and record update rights
Bind any delegated principal to receiver authorization, durable audit and revocation rules; no inferred rights from documentation
